title: Expression of Interest - Prequalification for Core Banking System
description: China Dasheng Bank Ltd wishes to engage interested and qualified OEMs/Authorized partners of Core Banking Systems to bid for prequalification for the selection of Core Banking System (CBS). The CBS should support multi-channel banking, regulatory integrations, and comprehensive banking functionalities. [Closing date 31 Oct 2024 per EOI document - expired; still advertised on cdbbank.co.tz marquee as of 2026-06-10]
eligibility: Qualified OEMs/Authorized partners of Core Banking Systems
